data.narrative: The student demonstrated extraordinary systems engineering mastery and production readiness rigor in Module 10. They designed and validated a hardened multi-service deployment architecture, decoupled process liveness from external dependency readiness to prevent restart storms, implemented coordinated graceful connection draining, authored a non-root multi-stage Dockerfile and CI merge gates, and rapidly diagnosed and remediated an over-coupled database check in the readiness probe to achieve a flawless 7/7 verification and complete the curriculum.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed single-container vs. multi-service deployment tradeoffs, identifying that while multi-service introduces distributed network boundary coordination, it is necessary to preserve the sub-millisecond public redirect SLA against heavy background analytics I/O and allow asymmetric queue-depth auto-scaling.
dimension_scores.evidence: Selected Option B (multi_service) citing event-loop fault isolation, asymmetric horizontal scaling, and the expand-and-contract zero-downtime migration pattern.

dimension_scores.observation: Immediately isolated the root cause of the readiness probe failure in Step 5, distinguishing between process-level vitality and downstream dependency checks and identifying that table-coupled queries fail before migrations run or introduce locking overhead.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed that GET /ready failed with HTTP 503 because the handler queried application tables rather than performing an engine-level connection pool ping, prescribing schema-agnostic SELECT 1.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced non-root container execution (USER node), eliminated hardcoded ports, and established strict boundaries separating immutable build-time Docker ARGs from runtime secret injection to protect production database credentials from registry leaks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Engineered multi-stage Dockerfile with non-root USER node and articulated why production secrets must never be baked into Docker layers or image history.

dimension_scores.observation: Tuned HTTP keep-alive timeouts (65s/66s) strictly above upstream reverse proxy idle windows to prevent 502 Bad Gateway race conditions, and coordinated SIGTERM graceful shutdown with immediate readiness flip and connection draining.
dimension_scores.evidence: Configured keepAliveTimeout=65000 and headersTimeout=66000, and validated graceful in-flight request completion during shutdown in verify-module-10.ts.

dimension_scores.observation: Articulated complex production failure modes—including cold-start thundering herds, keep-alive races, and expand-and-contract migration safety—with professional engineering precision and clarity.
dimension_scores.evidence: Clearly explained how /health prevents cascading cluster-wide restart storms during downstream database blips while /ready pauses load balancer routing without container kills.

strengths: Strong grasp of container lifecycle, liveness vs readiness, and fail-fast startup design.
First-principles incident triage isolating over-coupled dependency checks instantly.
Proactive defensive engineering tuning keep-alive socket timeouts to eliminate reverse proxy races.
Rigorous production discipline enforcing non-root container security and build-time secret isolation.
growth_areas: Apply this full-lifecycle system design mastery to real-time observability, instrumenting OpenTelemetry distributed tracing and SLO burn-rate alerts in production fleets.
data.recommendation: Deploy this multi-tenant URL shortener into production on Railway or AWS ECS using the verified DEPLOY.md runbook, and establish continuous SLO monitoring and game-day failover drills.
